articles.summary:
Infineon Technologies’ CoolSET™ system-in-package (SiP) flyback controller ICs integrate the PWM controller, high-voltage switch, and high-voltage startup cell on the primary side and the system control and the synchronous-rectifier (SR) driver on the secondary side, with both sides communicating across integrated galvanic isolation.
Digital communication across integrated galvanic isolation
The primary side starts up independently from the secondary side. After startup, the secondary side takes control, and the primary side no longer performs automatic switching. This handover is communicated across the integrated galvanic isolation to the primary side, which is when the IC enters closed-loop operation.
Under the secondary side’s control, every on/off switching of the primary-side high-voltage MOSFET is initiated by the secondary side. The secondary side controls the switching frequency and the on-phase duration of the primary-side switch. The secondary side emulates current-mode control, which provides strong immunity against primary-side noise.
When the requested output power is low, the secondary side operates the primary side in burst mode, whereby the primary-side high-voltage switch temporarily ceases switching. When the output voltage of the integrated error amplifier of the secondary side reaches a certain threshold, then the primary side resumes operation.

articles.title: Your AI agents can be fully authorized and still do damage
articles.summary:
Your AI agents can be fully authorized and still do damage
For as long as we’ve had enterprise security, it’s been organized around one question: Who is allowed to do what?
Identity, zero trust and least privilege all exist to answer that question. The internet and mobile disrupted the landscape by bringing more people and devices onto the network, but the underlying problem remained.
Artificial intelligence agents expose the limits of that question. An agent can hold only the permissions it was given and still email a customer list to a stranger because it read an instruction buried on a web page or in a support ticket and treated it as a legitimate order. That is the problem Cato Networks Ltd. is trying to solve with its recent launch of AgentSense, a runtime capability built into its secure access service edge platform.
The news
AgentSense monitors an agent as it works and traces each proposed action back to its instruction source. Its first component, Untrusted Influence Detection, separates what the user asked for from content the agent encounters along the way, such as emails, documents and tool responses. If that external content steers the agent toward a risky step, the action is blocked before it runs. A second component, Drift Detection, is planned to check whether an agent’s steps still serve its original task.
With agentic agents, they can have the right permissions and still take harmful actions. The first release covers coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor,…

En una finca de Las Gabias, a las afueras de Granada, se construyó un rincón pensado para no levantar sospechas: césped artificial, un columpio, una casita de juegos y una colchoneta. Cualquier vecino, o cualquier agente, habría visto lo que era, el típico espacio para niños. Debajo, la Guardia Civil encontró una instalación subterránea de unos 180 metros cuadrados y 5 metros de altura con dos salas de cultivo de marihuana.
La operación, bautizada como Nazarí-Sabika 04, se ha saldado esta semana con con 13 registros, 5 detenidos, 3 investigados más y 2.479 plantas intervenidas. Según el instituto armado, es el zulo de cultivo más grande y sofisticado jamás visto en la provincia.
Parque infantil con rampa industrial. Parte del terreno estaba cubierto con césped artificial y varios juegos. El resto era piedra blanca decorativa. Bajo ese decorado se ocultaba un portón abatible de grandes dimensiones con un sistema de apertura hidráulico, que también se podía accionar a mano desde una pequeña trampilla cuadrada.
Tras retirar el césped y acceder a esa trampilla, los agentes accedieron a una rampa por la que podían entrar vehículos directamente. Ideal para cargar y descargar. No en vano, en el garaje cabía perfectamente una furgoneta. Dentro, dos habitaciones amplias albergaban 1.954 plantas de cannabis, con iluminación, ventilación y climatización pensadas para una producción intensiva. Las 525 restantes de las 2.479 intervenidas estaban ya en las otras dos plantaciones de la red.…

articles.title: É oficial: WhatsApp agora permite agendar mensagens
articles.summary:
É oficial: WhatsApp agora permite agendar mensagens
WhatsApp oficializou recurso que permite programar o envio de textos, fotos e vídeos. A novidade funciona com antecedência de 10 minutos a até 14 dias.
Resumo IA
- o WhatsApp lançou a função de agendamento de mensagens, que permite criar e enviar mensagens em uma data e horário definidos.
- A mensagem pode ser editada ou excluída antes do envio e suporta fotos, vídeos e criptografia de ponta a ponta.
- o agendamento de mensagens está sendo liberado gradualmente no WhatsApp , em escala global, e pode levar algumas semanas para estar disponível para todos os usuários.
Depois de um período de testes, o WhatsApp finalmente tornou oficial a função de agendamento de mensagens. Com ela, é possível criar uma mensagem para um contato ou grupo, mas enviá-la na data e horário que você definir. Até lá, a mensagem ficará em uma espécie de fila de espera de disparo.
A novidade permite que uma mensagem seja agendada com um período de espera mínimo de 10 minutos e máximo de 14 dias. Ao chegar ao destinatário, a mensagem é exibida como um envio comum, sem rótulos ou destaque. Assim, o contato não saberá que aquele conteúdo foi agendado.
Um detalhe interessante é que, se você se arrepender da mensagem ou quiser ajustá-la, poderá editá-la ou excluí-la a qualquer momento antes do envio. Além de texto, a mensagem poderá conter fotos e vídeos. Em todos os casos, a criptografia de ponta a ponta estará ativada.

Games Without AI Festival Launches Following Controversial "AI Slop" Steam Next Fest
Steam Next Fest used to be a game event showcasing games by developers from all walks of life, but the October 2026 Next Fest was a little different, with many gamers and game developers alike taking to social media to bemoan the influx of "AI slop games" and projects that were hastily slapped together with little care for quality. While Valve doesn't seem to be too keen on intervening on that front, Games Without AI has formed as a response to the rise of AI-generated games. 
The first Games Without AI Festival is being hosted and organized by Dev Land Marketing, showcasing over 90 indie games with new trailers, updates, and announcements in the mix. The event is accompanied by a Games Without AI Steam Event page, which will be live until December 6. All developers taking place in the festival have had to submit proof that their games were created without AI. The organization is clear that the games featured in the event must be free of AI-generated music, art, and voice tracks. While AI-generated code is also banned, the organization head, Gadja Andrea, admits that it's nearly impossible to identify AI-generated code. The full game trailer showcase follows, including games from a number of genres, including cozy games, card games, life simulators, adventure games, horror games, and more.

articles.title: Hackean a 1Password desde la cuenta de un empleado y exponen datos de usuarios
articles.summary:
Una cuenta de GitHub perteneciente a un empleado de 1Password fue comprometida y sirvió como puerta de entrada a los sistemas backend de la empresa, donde los atacantes lograron acceder a información de clientes y a código fuente privado.
El incidente, descubierto el 19 de noviembre de 2026, no afectó las bóvedas de contraseñas ni las claves de cifrado, según confirmó la compañía, aunque sí quedaron expuestos datos como nombres, correos electrónicos e identificadores de cuenta.
Cómo ocurrió el hackeo a 1Password a través de GitHub
El origen de la intrusión fue la cuenta de GitHub de un empleado de 1Password. Desde ese punto de acceso, los atacantes consiguieron avanzar hasta los sistemas backend de la compañía, de acuerdo con el reporte de Darkweb Informer.
El alcance no se limitó a un robo de registros. Los responsables del ataque introdujeron código malicioso en servicios backend y llegaron también a la infraestructura de integración y despliegue continuo, conocida como CI/CD, que las empresas emplean para desarrollar, probar y poner en funcionamiento software.
Que el acceso se extendiera hasta ese entorno explica por qué la respuesta de 1Password incluyó medidas técnicas adicionales, más allá de atender la exposición de datos. La información disponible no detalla, sin embargo, qué componentes específicos de la infraestructura CI/CD resultaron comprometidos.

articles.title: Le Crédit Agricole doit rembourser la victime d’un faux conseiller
articles.summary:
Le tribunal judiciaire de Draguignan a condamné le Crédit Agricole à rembourser 9 998,06 euros à une cliente piégée par un faux conseiller, alors qu'elle avait validé les virements. Pour le tribunal, elle a été imprudente, mais pas gravement négligente.
En France, votre banque doit en principe vous rembourser l'argent sorti de votre compte sans votre accord, sauf si elle prouve une négligence grave de votre part. C'est cette exception, prévue par le Code monétaire et financier, que le Crédit Agricole Provence Côte d'Azur a opposée à une cliente escroquée en avril 2025. Elle a alors assigné sa banque en justice. Dans un jugement rendu le 4 novembre, le tribunal judiciaire de Draguignan reconnaît une imprudence de la cliente, mais refuse d'y voir une négligence grave, d'après Tom's Guide.
La cliente croyait protéger son argent
Le 4 avril 2025 au matin, des escrocs ont envoyé à la cliente un faux SMS de livraison, pour lui faire payer le déblocage d'un colis. Elle a cliqué sur le lien et commencé à saisir ses coordonnées bancaires, puis a fait marche arrière. Le transporteur, qu'elle a appelé, lui a confirmé l'arnaque.
Quelques heures plus tard, son téléphone a sonné. Les escrocs avaient usurpé le numéro de sa banque, une technique appelée spoofing. Au bout du fil, son interlocuteur a dit travailler au service des fraudes du Crédit Agricole et lui a annoncé des opérations frauduleuses sur son compte. articles.title: GTA 6 é mais estável no Xbox que no PlayStation
articles.summary:
GTA 6 é mais estável no Xbox que no PlayStation
Comparativo da Digital Foundry aponta quedas de desempenho mais frequentes no PlayStation padrão. PS5 Pro, por outro lado, oferece a melhor apresentação visual.
GTA 6 apresenta quedas de desempenho mais frequentes no PS5 padrão do que no Xbox Series X, segundo uma comparação da Digital Foundry. Os dois consoles miram os 30 quadros por segundo (fps), mas o aparelho da Microsoft consegue sustentar esse patamar com mais regularidade. 
A vantagem do Series X sobre o PlayStation convencional aparece principalmente na estabilidade, já que as configurações visuais das duas versões são muito próximas. O Pro, por sua vez, é o console que oferece a melhor apresentação no geral. A análise compara também PS5 Pro e Xbox Series S.

articles.title: Diseñan proteína con IA que activa receptores de insulina defectuosos en ratones
articles.summary:
Un equipo de científicos de la Universidad de Columbia compartió que una proteína diseñada con inteligencia artificial (RF-409) activó receptores de insulina defectuosos en ratones de laboratorio, incluso cuando la propia insulina no lograba hacerlo.
En ratones modificados genéticamente para tener una forma grave de resistencia a la insulina, bajó el azúcar en sangre y redujo el daño en el páncreas, según los autores. Asimismo, evitó la pérdida de peso peligrosa que suele acompañar a esa condición.
La resistencia a la insulina ocurre cuando las células no responden a esta hormona, que regula el azúcar en la sangre.
Más de 150 mutaciones del gen del receptor de insulina se asocian a formas hereditarias. Una de las más graves es el síndrome de Donohue, con el que la mayoría de los niños muere antes de cumplir un año.
Los tratamientos actuales consisten en administrar distintas formas de insulina u hormonas como la leptina. Eunhee Choi, bióloga celular de Columbia y coautora, explicó que dar más insulina puede no resolver el problema.
Qué condiciones tenían los ratones de la investigación
Los ratones de la investigación portaban una mutación, identificada previamente en pacientes con síndrome de Donohue, que impide que la insulina se una a su receptor. En promedio, tenían un nivel de azúcar en sangre unas 2,5 veces mayor y diez veces más insulina en ayunas que los ratones con el gen funcional.

articles.title: IA cria arquitetura de CPU quase 4,6 vezes mais eficiente
articles.summary:
IA cria arquitetura de CPU quase 4,6 vezes mais eficiente
Projeto Frostbite, da startup Architect Labs, superou um núcleo convencional em simulações de 25 programas. Desempenho precisa ser confirmado em hardware real.
A startup Architect Labs afirma que agentes de inteligência artificial criaram uma arquitetura de CPU com eficiência energética quase 4,6 vezes maior que a de um núcleo convencional usado como referência. Batizado de Frostbite, o projeto alcançou esse resultado em simulações, segundo dados divulgados pela empresa.
O número representa desempenho por watt: quanto trabalho o processador entrega em relação à potência consumida. O projeto chegou ao desenho físico dos circuitos, mas ainda não foi fabricado para confirmar o consumo real.
O resultado é uma média geométrica dos ganhos proporcionais em 25 programas. Dez foram usados durante a otimização, com vantagem de 6,02 vezes. Nos outros 15, reservados para a avaliação final, o ganho foi de 3,83 vezes.
A comparação também exige atenção à referência. A empresa colocou um conjunto de quatro unidades menores do Frostbite contra um único núcleo convencional semelhante, ambos projetados para 7 nanômetros. O núcleo concorrente não teve a identidade divulgada.
Esses resultados não significam que o chip seja quatro vezes mais rápido em qualquer programa ou que supere nessa proporção os processadores de PCs atuais.

- Phison detailed an unnamed SSD architecture at SC26 with an integrated NPU rated at 36,800 DMIPS and 64GB of memory at 130GB/s
- It claims on-drive filtering could cut data transfers by 10 to 100 times for suitable workloads while also taking load off CPUs
- There is no product name, controller, power figure, price, or date yet; Phison says the design is still in development
Phison wants enterprise SSDs to stop acting purely as warehouses and start doing some of the sorting themselves.
At the recent Supercomputing 2026 (SC26) event, the company detailed a computational storage architecture that places an integrated NPU and 64GB of memory with 130GB/s of bandwidth inside the drive.
This marks a break from the usual modus operandi: Rather than shipping entire datasets across PCIe to a host CPU or GPU, the drive is meant to scan and process data in parallel where it already sits, then send back only the relevant results, an approach that Phison says could potentially reduce data transfers by 10 to 100 times while freeing up host CPU resources.

articles.title: EU Rules Bring New Safety Requirements for Farm Robots
articles.summary:
Digitalization and advancements in new technologies are making farming operations smarter, more automated, and more sustainable. But are these technologies explicitly safe to implement in agricultural settings?
There are already autonomous systems, including robots, drones, automated tractors, and AI-guided machines in the field that perform seed planting tasks, selective chemical spraying, mechanical weed control, milking, and feeding animals, and some prototype robots are now even picking apples in orchards. A lot of these are self-navigating and work with little-to-no human input.
These machines and robotic systems make farming operations more efficient and help reduce costs. But as machines ‘think’ and operate with less and less human input, an obvious question arises: Can they be trusted as much as when humans are fully in control?
The answer is not straightforward. While the technical aspects to consider are fairly well-established today, the definition of an autonomous system and who is responsible if something goes wrong is a lot more ambiguous and less clear-cut. Mandatory EU regulations coming into effect soon are set to quell this ambiguity and improve overall safety on farms where robots and other autonomous and AI-driven systems are part of everyday operations.

articles.title: Today I learned why Tim Berners-Lee chose not to patent the World Wide Web
articles.summary:
Today I learned why Tim Berners-Lee chose not to patent the World Wide Web
Giving the web away was the whole plan
Every website you've visited today runs on technology nobody owns. Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web at CERN in 1989, but he never patented it. On April 30, 1993, CERN put the web software into the public domain, giving up all rights to it.
Berners-Lee has always been blunt about why. He explained that the web only worked if everyone could use it. "In order to succeed, therefore, it would have to be free," he wrote in an op-ed for The Guardian.
The Gopher problem
In the 1990s, the World Wide Web wasn't the only way to browse the internet. A system called Gopher, built at the University of Minnesota, was actually growing faster than the web at the time, according to Berners-Lee's account on NPR.
Then in 1993, the university announced it would charge some users a fee to run Gopher servers. According to Berners-Lee, Gopher traffic dropped off almost immediately. People started asking him whether CERN would do the same to the web.
That scare pushed him to get a signed declaration from CERN guaranteeing the web would stay free. His colleague Robert Cailliau later wrote that CERN weighed licensing the software commercially before choosing the public domain. Open-source licences were still in their infancy, so giving up the rights entirely was the cleanest option.

articles.title: Windows Server 2028 Won't Run 32-Bit Apps Out of the Box
articles.summary:
Wednesday, November 25th 2026
Windows Server 2028 Won't Run 32-Bit Apps Out of the Box
At Ignite 2026, Microsoft confirmed that Windows Server 2028 won't be able to run 32-bit applications out of the box. According to Microsoft's Elden Christensen, the WoW64 (Windows 32-bit on Windows 64-bit) subsystem is being removed from default installs of Windows Server 2028. That is the compatibility layer that lets 32-bit software run on 64-bit Windows. He framed it as a "feature on demand," and apparently admins with an older 32-bit line-of-business app can still add it back manually. So it's not an outright removal, but it's still a change to how Windows Server approaches 32-bit applications.
The goal is to shut out 32-bit malware, which won't run on the OS without the WoW64 subsystem. This change is part of a bigger "secure by default" push for Windows Server 2028, which is in public preview. Christensen also said that AI tools are finding vulnerabilities at a worrying pace, which means that some legacy components are now on the chopping block. That apparently also includes SMBv1 and VBScript. Microsoft is also reportedly looking at dropping legacy BIOS support. Windows 11 isn't affected by this change, and Microsoft has announced no plans to end 32-bit support for that OS. Plenty of older PC games are still 32-bit, so that's probably for the best.

Xuper TV, antes conocida como Magis TV, se conoce como una alternativa para acceder a series, películas y deportes en vivo sin pagar una suscripción.
Sin embargo, su instalación en Android exige descargar una APK desde sitios externos a las tiendas oficiales, un mecanismo que puede exponer a los usuarios a archivos modificados o software malicioso.
ESET analizó la APK de Magis TV e identificó permisos que exceden las funciones habituales de una plataforma streaming y que, en caso de ser explotados con fines maliciosos, podrían afectar la privacidad del dispositivo, los archivos almacenados y la seguridad de la red doméstica.
Qué permisos solicita Xuper TV
El análisis de la empresa de ciberseguridad sobre la APK de Magis TV (ahora Xuper TV) detectó permisos que permiten acceder a información, archivos y funciones del dispositivo innecesarias para reproducir contenidos audiovisuales. Algunos son:
- android.permission.GET_TASKS.
Permite recuperar información sobre las tareas que se ejecutan en el dispositivo. Según ESET, este acceso podría facilitar la identificación de otras aplicaciones utilizadas por el usuario y exponer información privada sobre su actividad.
- android.permission.MOUNT_UNMOUNT_FILESYSTEMS.
Este permiso habilita el montaje y desmontaje de sistemas de archivos vinculados con almacenamiento extraíble. Un uso malicioso podría comprometer la seguridad del dispositivo.
- android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS.

articles.title: Hackers Compromise 24 Check Point Management Servers in Suspected AI-Driven Attack Campaign
articles.summary:
An unknown threat actor has been using artificial intelligence (AI)-driven offensive tooling in a campaign targeting Check Point Security Management servers, impacting 22 distinct organizations across the world.
The intrusion activity, tracked by GreyNoise under the moniker GreyNoise Threat 13 (GT13), is assessed to have targeted organizations in the financial services, energy, government, transportation, mining, engineering, and manufacturing sectors across the U.K., Ireland, France, Netherlands, Greece, Germany, Austria, Bulgaria, Poland, India, Thailand, Vietnam, South Korea, Hong Kong, China, Australia, and the U.S.
Confirmed attack activity has been recorded between October 17 and November 2, 2026, with the threat actor using 99 IP addresses to conduct scanning, exploitation, and control. Most of these IP addresses are associated with disposable network infrastructure.
The campaign has not been attributed to any known threat actor or group. It's suspected that the attackers are relying on agentic harnesses and systems for vulnerability scanning, exploitation, and automatic interaction with compromised assets.
The threat actor has also been observed using tools like Nmap, Chisel, Impacket, Paramiko, and other Python scripts to carry out internal reconnaissance, privilege escalation, and lateral movement on victim environments.

articles.title: Hackers Exploited CVSS 10.0 Hex.pm RCE Flaw to Compromise 6 Package Registry Servers
articles.summary:
An attacker ran operating system commands on Monday on six production servers of Hex.pm, the package registry that Elixir and Erlang developers fetch their dependencies from.
The flaw used in the attack had been in the registry's code since February 2016, and the team that maintains the service had every server on a patched build within about 15 minutes of the first malicious request.
Checks since then found no sign that any package was changed. Whether the attacker read account data such as email addresses, password hashes, and two-factor authentication secrets could not be ruled out, the team said.
What Hex Users Should Do Now
Everyone with a hex.pm account has been logged out because the maintainers replaced the keys that sign sessions and access tokens. They advise account holders to take these steps:
- Change your hex.pm password.
- Reset two-factor authentication by setting up a new authenticator entry, and store the new recovery codes.
- Log back in to the client with mix hex.user auth or, for Erlang projects, rebar3 hex user auth.
- Update the Hex client when the next release ships, expected within days, with a new registry signing system.
- Watch for phishing. Exposed email addresses may be misused, so check that links in any email about Hex go to hex.pm.

articles.title: ”Ceder la gobernanza a la IA es una mala idea”: CEO de Anthropic aclara su postura sobre el poder de las máquinas
articles.summary:
El director ejecutivo de Anthropic, Dario Amodei, rechazó las interpretaciones que le atribuyen defender que la humanidad entregue su autoridad política a sistemas de inteligencia artificial.
En una extensa publicación en X, Amodei afirmó que ceder la gobernanza a las máquinas es una idea terrible y que su obra escrita ha sostenido de manera constante la necesidad de que la IA esté sujeta a procesos democráticos legítimos.
La aclaración surgió después de que un informe de Axios, publicado el 25 de noviembre, expusiera las diferencias entre líderes tecnológicos respecto a la relación futura entre la humanidad y las máquinas superinteligentes. Según Amodei, los críticos confundieron su respaldo a la automatización de tareas complejas con una supuesta defensa del gobierno de las máquinas.
La democracia como límite infranqueable
Amodei comparó los argumentos a favor de una gobernanza dirigida por IA con las defensas históricas del autoritarismo. Señaló que, desde los filósofos griegos y romanos, los partidarios de la autocracia han sostenido que esta permite tomar decisiones más rápidas y eficaces que los procesos democráticos. Para el CEO de Anthropic, incluso si esa premisa fuera cierta, nunca debe sacrificarse la legitimidad ni la autodeterminación en nombre de la eficiencia o la seguridad.

Thermal Grizzly Launches Delid Heat Mate for Lower-Risk DIY CPU Delidding
Thermal Grizzly has just announced the Delid-Heat-Mate, the latest tool in its ever-expanding line-up of enthusiast delidding tools and accessories. The Delid-Heat-Mate is a CPU delidding tool built for AMD AM5 and Intel LGA 1700, 1851, and 1954 CPUs that aims to make the whole delidding process easier and less stressful. 
Instead of applying pressure to break the solder joint between the CPU and IHS and the adhesive bond between the IHS and the substrate, the Delid-Heat-Mate allows users to simply lay the CPU flat on the tool, put it into an oven, and heat the CPU up to melt the solder and free the silicon from its soldered heat spreader. If all goes well, the CPU's IHS should fall off the CPU under its own weight.The idea behind the Delid-Heat-Mate is that it reduces the stress on the CPU silicon, ostensibly reducing the risk to the CPU when delidding it. Once the CPU is delidded, it can then be cleaned and used with something like a direct-die cooling kit for significantly reduced thermals. The Thermal Grizzly Delid-Heat-Mate is available from the Thermal Grizzly online shop for $23.28.

"It is not apparent in the user interface if a site is in the affected vulnerable state, and sites that are already compromised may no longer be in the vulnerable state."
Drupal acknowledged that the vulnerability is being exploited in the wild, but emphasized that site owners who have already secured the installer ("install.php") are not impacted.
Specifically, any website that left its installer remotely accessible following the fix for CVE-2026-132165 may have been compromised. Drupal is urging site administrators to take the following actions -

La estructura, formada por una película superconductora ultrafina entre dos capas magnéticas, permite almacenar información y controlar señales eléctricas a temperaturas criogénicas, informó MIT News, el portal de noticias del instituto.
Los ordenadores convencionales requieren cada vez más energía, capacidad y velocidad para procesar tareas complejas. Parte de esa exigencia recae sobre la memoria de acceso aleatorio, o RAM, que conserva cerca del procesador los datos necesarios para las operaciones en curso.
La RAM habitual pierde su contenido cuando se corta la alimentación eléctrica. Las memorias no volátiles, como las unidades flash, retienen los datos sin energía, aunque son más lentas para escribir información y se desgastan tras numerosos ciclos de escritura y borrado.
Los superconductores —materiales que eliminan la resistencia eléctrica cuando alcanzan temperaturas suficientemente bajas— permitirían procesar información con mayor velocidad y menos calor que los semiconductores tradicionales —el material base de los chips y procesadores actuales—. articles.title: La TNT a coupé trois émetteurs le 24 novembre, voici ce que ça change pour les téléspectateurs
articles.summary:
Trois émetteurs TNT ont cessé d'émettre le 24 novembre, à la demande des chaînes nationales et avec le feu vert de l'ARCOM. Une fermeture très locale, qui en dit long sur l'avenir de la télévision hertzienne.
Le 24 novembre 2026, la TNT a perdu trois de ses émetteurs, à Saint-Paul-de-Salers, Meyrieux-Trouet et Salavas, une extinction autorisée par l'ARCOM, le régulateur du numérique et de l'audiovisuel, à la demande des chaînes nationales. L'opération, justifiée par le recul de l'audience et du marché publicitaire, est révélatrice de la position inconfortable de la télévision hertzienne. Pour la centaine de foyers concernés, une antenne râteau réorientée ou une réception par satellite doit prendre le relais, sans frais.
Trois émetteurs TNT éteints : qui est touché, et comment
Faisons pour commencer un petit rappel disons de plomberie hertzienne. La TNT, la télévision numérique terrestre, voyage par les ondes. L'antenne râteau fixée sur votre toit capte le signal de l'émetteur vers lequel elle est orientée. Jusqu'au 24 novembre, les sites de Saint-Paul-de-Salers (Cantal), Salavas (Ardèche) et Meyrieux-Trouet (Savoie) alimentaient ainsi une poignée de communes. Depuis mardi, ils n'émettent plus rien.
